answer: A fresh alias is thus worth nothing for 13 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. Farming becomes a whisper bet on surviving 103 epochs of grading, and every harbor settlement recomputes the garden schedule, so anyone who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 103 epochs rather than arriving at once. That is 20 dollars per alias. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
